scope: Sequential main-thread correctness, regression, security/API, reliability and simplicity audit of the actual combined repair

The OS predicate mutation escapes before repair and is detected afterward.

limits: Original native inventory byte lists were not captured; precise CRLF attribution remains a supported hypothesis.
